sql: SELECT T.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS away_wins FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND M.season = '2009/2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id ORDER BY away_wins DESC LIMIT 1
